title_he: לֹא אֶחְיֶה אֲדוֹנִי בְּתוֹךְ מְבוּכַת הַזְּמָן
review: Chorus is verse 2 (four lines), C repeats all four joined by " · "; label القرار stays as data. The 8/4/8 shape is the printed chorus stanza; the two shortchorus half-lines 2:4 and the short 1:1/1:3 lines stay short as in the Arabic. Glossary: מְבוּכָה for حيرة, שֶׁלְשֶׁלֶת for قيد, חֻלְשָׁה for ضعف, שָׁלוֹם for أمان, מִשְׁעָן for ضمان. 2:1-2:2 keep the repeated בְּחֵיקְךָ of the Arabic's في حضنك; 2:4 "ترنيمتي" as זְמִירָתִי.
